input: What is the total revenue from completed orders?

expected.sql: SELECT SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id=o.id WHERE o.status='completed'

input: List the name of each customer from Singapore, alphabetically.

expected.sql: SELECT name FROM customers WHERE country='Singapore' ORDER BY name

input: Show each product category and its number of products.

expected.sql: SELECT category, COUNT(*) FROM products GROUP BY category

input: List the names of customers who have never placed an order.

expected.sql: SELECT c.name FROM customers c LEFT JOIN orders o ON c.id=o.customer_id WHERE o.id IS NULL

input: List the names of products priced over 1000.

expected.sql: SELECT name FROM products WHERE price>1000
